_comment: 来源：mod 仓库 _docs/data/units/舰队铳手兵种设计.md；name 取 loc land_units_onscreen_name，desc／story 取 loc unit_description_short_texts／unit_description_historical_texts（中英原文）。

role.zh: 轻甲火器远程步兵 · T2

v.zh: 长铳（远程直射）＋佩刀（近战自卫）
v.en: Long gun (direct fire) and sword (for self-defence in melee)

v.zh: 提督卧舱（2 级）／提督议事厅（3 级）／舰队统帅厅（4 级）／玉海旗舰厅（5 级），玉海舰队游牧主城建筑链
v.en: Admiral's Quarters (tier 2) / Admiral's Council Hall (3) / Fleet Command Hall (4) / Jade Sea Flagship Hall (5), in the main horde building chain

k.zh: 远程武器威力（基础／破甲）

n.zh: 铅丸以破甲为主，与帝国火枪手相同
n.en: Mostly armour-piercing, the same as Empire Handgunners

desc.zh: 铅丸直射，破甲 17 为主
作为阴相单位参与阴阳宁和
desc.en: Counts as a Yin unit for Battle Harmony

desc.zh: 浅水中近战攻击、近战防御 ×1.2，且不减速（普通步兵是攻击、速度各 ×0.8）
desc.en: In shallow water: melee attack and melee defence ×1.2, with no loss of speed (ordinary infantry suffer ×0.8 to attack and speed)

wh3_main_unit_passive_battle_harmony_yin.zh: 阴阳宁和生效时：速度 +4%、领导力 +4、装填技能 +12
wh3_main_unit_passive_battle_harmony_yin.en: While in Battle Harmony: speed +4%, leadership +4, reload skill +12
